title: Coefficient-layer triangle with explicit endpoints
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum, $M$ any derived completed-coefficient object, and $n\geq0$. Let $L_n,E_n$ be the explicit objects of [def-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-coefficient-layer-data] and $M_{n+1}$ the actual successor scalar reduction. There exists a distinguished triangle $T$ in $D(R_{n+1})$ with isomorphisms $T_1\cong L_n$, $T_2\cong M_{n+1}$ and $T_3\cong E_n$. No local model, support bound, or cohomology finiteness hypothesis or conclusion is part of this assertion.

Apply DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES to the short exact sequence. Its distinguishedness is supplied by triangleOfSES_distinguished; invert the three representative comparisons to obtain the required endpoint isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_coefficient_layer_triangle
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ T : Triangle (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1}
      (completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1)))),
      T ∈ distTriang _ ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ finiteQuotientLayerObject X d M n) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ (completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ finiteQuotientPreviousObject X d M n)
